JOB TITLE:  Product Delivery – Forecast to Report - Application Developer, Senior Level 

 Career Framework Job Family:   Application Development 

 Grade Level: 6 – Application Developer, Sr. 

  

       

 JOB SUMMARY:  

 The Oracle Planning Application Developer is responsible for the design, development, support, optimization, and continuous improvement of enterprise financial planning and forecasting solutions. This position serves as a technical contributor across application development, production support, system integration, automation, and solution delivery activities supporting Forecast-to-Report (F2R) capabilities and related enterprise platforms. 

  

 The role will design, build, configure, and support custom applications, integrations, and enhancements that extend vendor-delivered Oracle capabilities while ensuring compatibility with future platform updates. The successful candidate will partner closely with business stakeholders, architects, product teams, and support organizations to deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with Southern Company's strategic objectives. 

  

 A key expectation of this role is the effective use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a development partner throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). The successful candidate will leverage AI-enabled tools and capabilities to accelerate solution design, improve code quality, optimize troubleshooting activities, enhance documentation, automate repetitive tasks, and identify innovative opportunities to improve business outcomes. AI is viewed as a force multiplier that augments engineering productivity, improves delivery quality, and enables faster realization of business value.   

 This position supports Oracle Planning and associated enterprise platforms including Oracle Financials, Oracle HCM, UI Planner, PowerPlan , Oracle Projects, Allocations, and other integrated solutions. The individual must possess strong technical, analytical, and communication skills and be capable of thriving in a collaborative Agile environment while maintaining a strong focus on operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

  

 Responsibilities : 

 Application Development & AI-Accelerated Engineering   

 Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise-level software applications, integrations, and configurations that support budgeting, forecasting, allocation, and reporting processes. 

 

 Utilize AI-powered development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, refactoring, documentation creation, and problem-solving activities. 

 
 Develop high-quality, maintainable, secure, and scalable solutions that adhere to Southern Company's engineering standards and architectural principles. 

 
 Apply AI-assisted techniques to identify development efficiencies, reduce technical debt, improve maintainability, and increase overall developer productivity. 

 
 Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, security, compliance, performance, and business alignment before deployment. 

  

 
 Solution Design & Innovation 

 Collaborate with architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to evaluate and design technical solutions that address business challenges. 

 
 Apply critical thinking and AI-assisted analysis to evaluate alternative solution approaches and recommend optimal designs. 

 
 Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve operational reliability, and enhance user experiences through emerging technologies and AI capabilities. 

 
 Participate in strategic roadmap development and modernization initiatives across Finance and Enterprise Planning platforms. 

  

 
 System Integration & Automation 

 Design and support API-based integrations between enterprise systems. 

 
 Develop and maintain automated data movement processes supporting Oracle Planning and related applications. 

 
 Leverage AI capabilities to accelerate integration analysis, data mapping validation, troubleshooting, and monitoring improvements. 

 
 Ensure data integrity, performance, and resilience across connected systems. 

  

 
 Production Support & Operational Excellence   

 Troubleshoot complex application , integration, and data-related issues across enterprise environments. 

 
 Utilize AI-assisted diagnostics and analysis tools to accelerate root cause identification and issue resolution. 

 
 Support critical business processes by monitoring application health, integration performance, and batch processing activities. 

 
 Conduct root cause analyses and identify automation or preventive measures that reduce recurring incidents. 

 
  
 Quality Engineering 


 Develop and execute comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing. 

 
 Utilize AI-assisted testing capabilities to generate test scenarios, improve test coverage, identify edge cases, and accelerate defect detection 

 
 Continuously improve software quality, reliability, and performance through automation and engineering best practices. 

 
 Participate in peer reviews of both human-authored and AI-assisted code changes. 

  

 
 Documentation & Knowledge Management 

 Develop and maintain architecture diagrams, technical specifications, support documentation, runbooks, and implementation guides. 

 
 Leverage AI tools to improve documentation quality, consistency, accessibility, and maintainability. 

 
 Create reusable knowledge assets that enhance organizational learning and operational support capabilities. 

  

 
 Continuous Learning & Emerging Technologies 

 Maintain awareness of industry trends, enterprise technologies, Oracle platform enhancements, and AI advancements. 

 
 Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and recommend responsible adoption opportunities that deliver measurable value. 

 
 Contribute to establishing and evolving AI engineering best practices within the organization. 

 
 Promote a culture of experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

 
  

 
  

 Education & Experience: 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Information Systems, Accounting, Engineering, or related field 

 
 5+ years of experience supporting and developing enterprise applications, preferably Oracle EPM Planning solutions. 

 
 Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools as part of software engineering, automation, troubleshooting, documentation, or testing activities. 

 
 Strong understanding of software development lifecycle methodologies and modern development practices. 

 

 Experience with API-based integrations between enterprise systems. 

 
 Working knowledge of Oracle Planning including business rules, Groovy scripting, calculation scripting, and financial planning processes. 

 
 Strong SQL and data analysis capabilities. 

 
 Experience supporting enterprise integrations and middleware technologies 

 
 Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and perform root cause analysis 

  

 Preferred: 

 
 Experience implementing AI-enabled engineering tools and workflows. 

 
 Experience with prompt engineering, AI-assisted solution design, and AI-powered code analysis. 

 
 Experience developing automation solutions utilizing AI services and APIs 

 
 Oracle EPM certifications 

 
 Knowledge of cloud-native and AI-enabled development patterns. 

 
  

 
  

 Knowledge, Technical Skills & AI Capabilities: 

 Demonstration of good understanding in several concepts including: 

  

 Strong understanding of enterprise software engineering principles. 

 
 Strong understanding of financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, allocation, and reporting processes. 

 
 Demonstrated ability to combine human expertise with AI-assisted capabilities to drive superior outcomes. 

 
 Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills. 

 

 Understands principles of Responsible AI including transparency, accountability, security, privacy, fairness, and human oversight. 

 
 Understanding of Cloud Services is required 

 
 Basic understanding of Security 

 
 Understanding Agile concepts and Incident Management is preferred 

 
 Business Continuity planning and execution is required 

 
 Shares AI best practices across teams to improve engineering effectiveness.  

 
 Identifies opportunities to responsibly incorporate AI capabilities into business processes and technology solutions. 

 
 Scripting, Process Automation and Optimization is strongly preferred 

  

 
 Behavioral Attributes  

 Takes personal ownership of career development. 

 
 Demonstrates “ Our Values ” - Safety First, Intentional Inclusion (We are One Team), Act with Integrity, Superior Performance 

 
 Quintessential learner with a high level of interest in applying new technologies and concepts. 

 
 Results-oriented, can act with speed and decisiveness while effectively problem-solving and communicating to various levels of leadership. 

 
 Focus on quality, reliability, and efficiency. 

 
 Effective in organizing tasks, managing multiple priorities, meeting schedules, and delivering on commitments. 

 
 Methodical approach to solving problems. 

 
 Demonstrates multiplier mindset – actively amplifies the capabilities of teammates rather than creating dependency  

 



  



 
 About Southern Company 

 Southern Company (NYSE:  SO ) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. Providing clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy with excellent service is our mission. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Through an industry-leading commitment to innovation, resilience and sustainability, we are taking action to meet customers' and communities' needs while advancing our goal of net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050. Our uncompromising values ensure we put the needs of those we serve at the center of everything we do and are the key to our sustained success. We are transforming energy into economic, environmental and social progress for tomorrow. Our corporate culture has been recognized by a variety of organizations, earning the company awards and recognitions that reflect Our Values and dedication to service. To learn more, visit  www.southerncompany.com . 



 
 



 
 Southern Company invests in the well-being of its employees and their families through a comprehensive total rewards strategy that includes competitive base salary, annual incentive awards for eligible employees and health, welfare and retirement benefits designed to support physical, financial, and emotional/social well-being. This position may also be eligible for additional compensation, such as an incentive program, with the amount of any bonus/awards subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan(s). A summary of the benefits offered for this position can be found here https://seo.nlx.org/southernco/pdf/SOCO-Benefits.pdf . Additional and specific details about total compensation and beneﬁts will also be provided during the hiring process.



 
 



 
 Southern Company is an equal opportunity employer where an applicant's qualifications are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other basis prohibited by law.
